mods.name: shakespeare-mode
mods.description: Prose in Early Modern English flair. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

mods.name: caveman-mode
mods.description: Prose in short caveman speech ("Fix bug. Test pass."), still accurate. Code and commands stay exact.

mods.name: eli5-mode
mods.description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

mods.name: code-only
mods.description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.

mods.name: gitmoji-commits
mods.description: Commit messages start with the matching gitmoji (✨ feat, 🐛 fix). Composes with conventional-commits: emoji goes before the type.

mods.name: fun-pack
mods.description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.
